name: find_text_on_screen
description:
Uses Windows native Hardware-Accelerated OCR to detect and locate text labels on the screen.
Returns matched text, bounding box [x, y, width, height], and center coordinate [cx, cy] for each hit.

query.description: Substring or phrase to search for (case-insensitive). If empty, returns all text found on screen.

take_new_screenshot.description: If True, captures fresh screenshot before OCR. If False, runs OCR on latest cached screenshot.
